stemMd: Events A and B have P(A)=0.5, P(B)=0.4 and P(A∩B)=0.2. What is P(A∪B)?
explanationMd: Inclusion-exclusion gives P(A∪B)=P(A)+P(B)−P(A∩B)=0.5+0.4−0.2=0.7. The overlap is otherwise counted twice in the simple sum.

distractorRationale.d: This adds both probabilities without subtracting the overlap.
distractorRationale.a: This is the intersection, not the union.
distractorRationale.b: This subtracts the overlap from only one event.
distractorRationale.e: This adds the overlap instead of subtracting it.
